title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (2/20): Daiyu Arrives at the Jia Mansion
note_en: This episode uses verb + 下 several times: 住下 "settle in," 流下眼泪 "shed tears," 留下 "leave behind." Here 下 doesn't really mean "down"; it signals that the action has reached a settled, lasting result, much like English "settle down" or "write down." So 黛玉就在贾府住下了 means not just that Daiyu lived there, but that she settled in to stay.
